892.name: New Jeevan Dhara-II
892.deferment: 2 to 15 years for Regular premium (premium paying term = deferment period); 1 to 15 years for Single premium. No policy term - the annuity is paid for life.
892.max_age: 65 or 70 years minus the deferment period, depending on the option (vesting by 65 for Options 1, 3, 4, 8; by 70 for Options 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11).

892.annuity_options: Single Life: 1 Life annuity; 2 with Return of Premium; 3/4 with 50%/100% Return of Premium at age 75; 5/6 with 50%/100% at age 80; 7 with 5% Return of Premium every year from 76 to 95; 10 Single premium with Return of Purchase Price. Joint Life: 8 Life annuity; 9 with Return of Premium; 11 Single premium with Return of Purchase Price.
